description: §52.8 — a PUBLIC server-authority <each> (seeded, row template fully SSR-renderable) inside an AUTHOR-WRITTEN <template> element falls back to client-only first-paint render, and the compiler fires I-SSR-EACH-CLIENT-RENDERED (info). No `if=` is involved: a `<template>`'s content is a document fragment by the HTML standard, so nothing inside it is part of any first paint. NO E-* — the each compiles normally; only the SSR first-paint acceleration is declined.
rationale: g-ssr-each-under-if-blank-paint (S433 fix round). The `if=` lowering was only ONE route into a `<template>`; the author's literal tag is another, and it produced the identical silent signature — a renderer emitted, the rows present in the composed first-paint BYTES, and zero rows reachable from `document`. Measured, not inferred. Covering only the lowered hosts would have left the same silence reachable by a shorter path.
